connector.name: YTDL RMCP
connector.registryDescription: Rust MCP server and CLI for yt-dlp search, downloads, metadata, transfers, and Plex playlists.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ytdl-rmcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.dinglebear. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: YTDLP_PLEX_URL

env.name: YTDLP_ACOUSTID_CLIENT_KEY

env.name: YTDL_RMCP_BINARY_VERSION
env.description: Optional GitHub release tag override for the downloaded YTDL RMCP binary.

env.name: YTDL_RMCP_RELEASE_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional release download base URL override.

env.name: RUST_LOG
env.description: Tracing filter for YTDL RMCP logs.
